description: REAL ACTION: creates leads from portal enquiry mails. Skips what is already taken in (per source and enquiry reference), skips what the reader did not recognise as an enquiry, and attaches to an EXISTING lead when the e-mail address is already known instead of creating a second one. What could not be read is written onto the lead in plain words — nothing is guessed and nothing is dropped.
name: import_portal_enquiries
